Employee Access

Name: WrapperExplore DeleteMe-B2D8, POS ID: 99002

By selecting an template from the available templates it will load a set of pre-configured permissions chosen to help out during setup. It is not required to choose any template and, even if you choose one, the permission set for each employee is completely custom.

Action Approval Authority

When Granted this user has access to all POS features and can approve any Action for users requiring approval.

Permissions

GeneralView Options

View Permissions

Manager Approval

The permission to approve actions that require manager approval.

Time Clock

The permission to clock in or out employees.

Reports

The permission to run reports.

Back Office Internet

The permission to launch the browser with back office.

SPS Admin

The permission to activate, cancel, and change tags, plans and updates credit card information.

TransactionView Options

View Permissions

Return Transaction

The permission to return or refund a transaction.

Open Cash Drawer

The permission to open the cash drawer.

Tax Exempt

The permission to toggle tax exempt on transactions.

Price Change

The permission to change item prices in a transaction.

Comp Sale

The permission to comp a transaction.

Prompt For Price

The permission to apply a price to selected items with no price.

Rewash Transaction

The permission to rewash a transaction.

Rewash Transaction With Code

The permission to generate 1 time use code for a rewash transaction.

Paid In & Paid OutView Options

View Permissions

Paid In

The permission to create a transaction with a paid in item.

Paid Out

The permission to create a transaction with a paid out item.

CustomerView Options

View Permissions

Customer Add

The permission to add a customer.

Customer Edit

The permission to edit a customer.

VehicleView Options

View Permissions

Vehicle Add

The permission to add a vehicle.

Vehicle Edit

The permission to edit a vehicle.

ItemView Options

View Permissions

Item Add

The permission to add an item.

Item Edit

The permission to edit an item.

Gift CardView Options

View Permissions

Gift Card Add

The permission to add a gift card.

Gift Card Edit

The permission to edit a gift card.

House AccountView Options

View Permissions

House Account Add

The permission to add a house account.

House Account Edit

The permission to edit a house account.

Wash BookView Options

View Permissions

Wash Book Add

The permission to add a wash book.

Wash Book Edit

The permission to edit a wash book.

PosView Options

View Permissions

Login

The permission to login to the main POS interface.

Cash Drop

The permission to perform a session cashdrop on POS.

Panel External

The permission to view the external POS panel on POS.

Open Refund

The permission to create an open refund.

DiscountView Options

View Permissions

Dollar Discount

The permission to apply a dollar discount.

Percent discount

The permission to apply a percent discount.

Instant Promotion

The permission to apply an instant promotion.
